name: Iron Curtain
desc: All enemies deal 75% damage (rounded down) for the rest of the run.

name: Opening Salvo
desc: At battle start, a random enemy loses 50% max HP and a random hero loses 20%.

name: Bulwark Aura
desc: Every hero gains 3 shield at the start of each enemy turn.

name: Nanite Field
desc: Every hero heals 3 HP at the start of each enemy turn.

name: Plague Protocol
desc: All enemies begin every battle with 3 Burn.

name: Overcharge
desc: All heroes deal 130% damage on ability hits (rounded up).

name: Signal Jam
desc: All enemies begin every battle with a permanent -2 roll penalty.

name: Coordinated Strike
desc: All heroes begin every battle with a permanent +2 roll bonus.

name: Resonance Cascade
desc: Burn on enemies ticks for +2 damage.

name: Gravity Well
desc: At the start of each enemy turn, all living enemies take 2 damage.

name: Protocol Override
desc: Items cost 0 Protocol and grant +1 Protocol when used.

name: Entropy Leak
desc: Battles 6+: enemies spawn at 85% HP.

name: Chain Reaction
desc: When an enemy dies, all other living enemies take 4 damage.

name: Vengeance Protocol
desc: When an ally falls, your surviving squad's next roll is all 20s (once per battle).

name: Overload Loop
desc: 20s resolve their effects twice.

name: Curated Cache
desc: Rewards never include common items.

name: Overflow Buffer
desc: Carry 50% unspent Protocol into the next battle.

name: Field Cache
desc: Start each battle with 1 random consumable.

name: Mercy Protocol
desc: Revives restore full HP instead of the usual penalty.

name: Emergency Signal
desc: First time an ally drops below 50% HP, squad gains +2 roll for 1 turn.

name: Aegis Field
desc: Any heal grants all allies 3 shield.

name: Standing Order
desc: Every unit's high-roll ability triggers 1 lower.

name: Static Field
desc: Enemy dice are Jammed (cap 10) on turn 1 of every battle.

name: Twin Fates
desc: Once per battle, copy one hero die's result to another, free.

name: Overflow Vent
desc: Protocol past the cap deals 2 damage to a random enemy per point.

name: Salvage Directive
desc: Killing a Marked enemy refunds 2 Protocol.

name: Cold Logic
desc: Enemies with frozen dice take +4 damage.

name: Chain Doctrine
desc: Your Chains jump one extra time.

name: Scavenger Manifest
desc: The first kill each battle drops a random consumable.

name: Dead Man's Hand
desc: First squad wipe each run: all heroes survive at 1 HP and roll 20s.

name: Salvage Rig
desc: +1 Protocol when an enemy shield fully breaks.

name: Chitin Graft
desc: Heroes heal 3 on their kills.

name: Resonant Chorus
desc: Turn 1 dice can't land below 8.

name: Root Access
desc: Once per battle, Set costs 0.

name: Mantle Core
desc: Your shields persist until broken.
